events.title: Molten Universe Festival Vol. 3
events.note: A real four-band fuzz / stoner / noise-rock bill right across the German border.
events.why: Probably the most surgical QOTSA pick: Cincinnati desert-rock band Valley of the Sun, Bongloard’s blunt Dutch noise-punk, plus Yeast Machine’s stoner/grunge/psych riffs. Four announced acts, not a vague festival guess.

events.title: Midwife + Devin Shaffer
events.note: Bleak, heavy-lidded slowcore and guitar distortion. One of the closest Her New Knife-adjacent nights in Maastricht.
events.why: The shoegaze connection is the haze, feedback and emotional weight. Midwife is slower and much more spacious.

events.title: Psychedelic Porn Crumpets + Gros Coeur
events.note: A hyperactive wall of psych fuzz, rowdy garage-punk and huge riffs. Closest to QOTSA’s chaotic desert-rock side.
events.why: A hyperactive wall of psych fuzz, rowdy garage-punk and huge riffs. Closest to QOTSA’s chaotic desert-rock side.

events.title: Lily Seabird
events.note: Intimate folk suddenly breaks into frayed, distorted guitars. A strong quiet-to-loud, grunge-adjacent Her New Knife detour.
events.why: Intimate folk suddenly breaks into frayed, distorted guitars. A strong quiet-to-loud, grunge-adjacent Her New Knife detour.

events.title: Water Damage
events.note: Extreme repetition and droning guitar pieces. Experimental rather than typical verse/chorus shoegaze.
events.why: For the harsh, textural edge of Her New Knife: Water Damage stretch guitars into hypnotic, abrasive drone. More locked-in repetition and less punchy grunge than HNK—an intentional left-field pick.

events.title: Turpentine Valey & Ka'Una
events.note: Atmospheric, heavy guitar textures.
events.why: Layered, textural guitar music with a heavy post-rock edge; less hook-driven, more cinematic.

events.title: ACID INVADERZ III
events.note: Tekno, tribe, acidcore and darkpsy: the fiercer DIY/free-party edge, not standard hard-techno programming.
events.why: Industrial-adjacent intensity but a different scene: the official bill is TEKNO / TRIBE / ACIDCORE plus DARKPSY. Watch PNEUMATIX and ABEM for warped 303 pressure, not a typical UNWIND-style hard-techno lineup.

events.title: Swimming Paul
events.note: Melodic club music with trance elements.
events.why: A melodic club crossover. More house than Arman John’s fast, acidic hard trance—consider this a softer detour.

events.title: FRIDAY
events.note: Left-field indie-rock from the Dutch scene.
events.why: A broad indie-rock connection rather than a direct noise-rock match. Explore if you want a less abrasive guitar night.

events.title: LINK: Dave Clarke / DJ Hell / Pierre & Dany Rodriguez
events.note: An uncompromising night of techno legends.
events.why: Hard-edged, underground techno lineage. Less modern schranz than UNWIND, with more classic Detroit tension.

events.title: HOTLINE: Lisa Korver & Paige Tomlinson
events.note: Peak-time trance and hard house with a fast groove.

events.title: Portland + Rosie Stuart
events.note: Dream-pop atmosphere; softer than Her New Knife.
events.why: A softer dream-pop/indie detour if you like the melodic fog more than the distorted edges.

events.title: Kadavar
events.note: Huge analogue fuzz and retro-heavy psych riffing, a direct QOTSA/stoner-rock bridge.
events.why: Thick analogue distortion, heavy swinging riffs and classic psych-rock grooves. More retro/70s than QOTSA, but one of the strongest matches for their stoner/desert-rock side.

events.title: High Hi
